verses.text: Thank the LORD because he’s good. His faithful love lasts forever.
Let the people the LORD bought back say it out loud. He rescued them from the enemy’s grip
and gathered them from far-off lands, from east and west, from north and south.
They wandered through the desert wilderness and couldn’t find a city to call home.
Hungry and thirsty, they felt their lives slipping away.
Then they cried to the LORD in their trouble, and he pulled them out of their distress.
He led them down a straight road to a city where they could live.
Let them praise the LORD for his faithful love and the wonders he does for people!
He satisfies those who thirst and gives the hungry their fill of good things.
Some sat in darkness, in the shadow of death, bound in misery and iron chains,
because they rebelled against God’s words and brushed off the Most High’s advice.
So he wore them down with hard labor. They collapsed, and nobody came to help.
Then they cried to the LORD in their trouble, and he saved them out of their distress.
He led them out of darkness and the shadow of death and snapped their chains.
Let them praise the LORD for his faithful love and the wonders he does for people!
He smashed the bronze gates and cut through the iron bars.
Fools suffered for their rebellion and the wrong they’d done.
They couldn’t stand any food and came close to the gates of death.
Then they cried to the LORD in their trouble, and he saved them out of their distress.
He sent his word and healed them. He pulled them back from their graves.
Let them praise the LORD for his faithful love and the wonders he does for people!
Let them bring sacrifices of thanks and sing about everything he’s done.
Some took ships out to sea and made their living trading on the open waters.
They saw what the LORD does, the wonders he works out in the deep.
At his command a storm blew up and sent the waves towering.
They rose as high as the sky and plunged back into the depths. Their courage melted away in the danger.
They reeled and staggered like drunk people. They were at their wits’ end.
Then they cried to the LORD in their trouble, and he brought them out of their distress.
He quieted the storm until the waves lay still.
They were glad when it went quiet, and he brought them to the harbor they’d been hoping to reach.
Let them praise the LORD for his faithful love and the wonders he does for people!
Let them honor him in the gathering of the people and praise him where the elders sit.
He turns rivers into desert and springs into parched ground.
He turns fertile land into salt flats because of the evil of the people living there.
He turns deserts into pools and dry ground into gushing springs.
He settles hungry people there, where they can build a city to live in.
They sow fields, plant vineyards, and bring in a good harvest.
He blesses them so their families grow, and he keeps their herds from dwindling.
Then their numbers shrink again, and oppression, trouble, and grief press them down.
He pours contempt on rulers and makes them wander in a wasteland with no paths.
But he lifts the needy out of their suffering and grows their families like flocks.
Those who live uprightly will see it and be glad. The wicked will have nothing to say.
Anyone who’s wise will pay attention to all of this and think about the ways the LORD shows his faithful love.
